title: Nora Core v1.6.0 - Dev Tools Folder, Navy Theme & Midnight Palette
highlights: Added gitignored `tools/` with a double-click Windows launcher `tools/build-app.bat` (plus `build-app.ps1`); agents must not run production `tauri build` unless the user explicitly asks
Dark theme recast as Dark Navy Slate for better contrast; new Midnight Black theme selectable in Settings
Core checkout now includes `src/index.css` so child apps receive Navy/Midnight tokens; omitting it left stale palettes after core update
Docs-First Git rule: changelog, README, and affected docs must be updated before every core commit because child apps consume this repository

title: Nora Core v1.5.0 - In-App Toasts, Process Monitor & Agent Guardrails
highlights: Strict Core vs App agent rules: child apps must not edit `src/core/`, `src/components/ui/`, or `src-tauri/`
In-app toast, interactive confirm dialogs, and header notification bell with the last 10 messages
Live sidecar/cron monitor at `/tasks/processes` with `appId:` namespace isolation
Zero C-Drive Pollution: portable storage next to the executable only

title: Nora Core v1.4.0 - Portable-First Storage & Zero C-Drive
highlights: Embedded sidecars extract to `bin/` beside the running `.exe` instead of Windows drive C
Injected `PORTABLE_APP_DIR` and default working directory on the portable app root for all child processes
Per-app `updaterEndpoint` required; version-simulation tools stay DEV-only

title: Nora Core v1.3.0 - Standalone Single-File Embedded Sidecars
highlights: Binaries in `src/app/assets/bin/` are compiled into the main `.exe` via `include_bytes!`
First-run extraction is automatic and invisible; child apps can ship as a true single-file portable

title: Nora Core v1.2.0 - Embedded Sidecar & Smart Multi-Path Discovery
highlights: Supported Embedded Sidecars inside single portable application bundles (`src/app/assets/bin/`)
Added multi-path resolution (`resolve_sidecar_path`) across portable exe dir, AppData, and bundled resources
Added `get_sidecar_directories` for retrieving standard application data and bin directories
Automatic bundle resource inclusion in `sync-app-config.mjs` for embedded binaries
Enhanced sidecar process lifecycle management and graceful shutdown

title: Nora Core v1.1.0 - Sidecar Architecture & Dynamic Config
highlights: Added Generic Sidecar Service for background engine execution (Python, C++, Go, Node)
Implemented automatic lifecycle cleanup: child processes killed on app termination
Added port conflict pre-flight check before sidecar startup
Created dynamic configuration synchronizer (`scripts/sync-app-config.mjs`)
Added support for custom child app icons in `src/app/assets/icons/`
Isolated dev and release simulation tools strictly to development mode (`DEV only`)

title: Initial Release of Nora Base
highlights: Modular Tauri 2.0 + React 18 + TypeScript + Tailwind architecture
Frameless Windows 11 titlebar and dynamic system integration
3-level adaptive navigation sidebar
Hardware abstraction layer for Serial COM ports and printers
Offline-first design with local changelog and updater foundation
